risk_summary: The excerpt presents meaningful financial and capital-structure risk, including Nasdaq equity deficiencies, constrained liquidity covenants, repeated equity offerings, substantial warrant dilution, and reliance on investor consent. Disclosure is generally highly specific on transaction terms but is interspersed with boilerplate risk disclaimers and promotional, difficult-to-verify product claims. Overall tone is cautiously negative despite management’s favorable descriptions of the business and technology.
